verdict.rationale: Data-use and AI-training policy is a fair question for a payments service that handles merchant and shopper data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an opt-out from AI model training or any data-use controls. The MCP server and LLM-client items describe developer tooling, not training-data controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
